[[Category:Bloodline games|Kelabras]]
==About the Game==

Kelabras is not a classic Bloodline game as there is only one player (currently) - me. I wanted to take a journal like game (or more in the same world) and take a storylike journal about it. Since there is no other category I have chosen bloodlines for it.

==Player(s)==

Currently, the only player is [[User:vooood|vooood]] playing the game.
:''I have discovered this game only a week back and immediately fell in love with it. After several failures and not so bad games I decided to go after a historical game.''
